title: Choose the final composition
question: The visual world is fixed. Choose how the document, navigation, and annotation margin should share the window.

options.label: Quiet Margin
options.thesis: A conventional top folio and dark annotation margin let the document remain the unquestioned center.
options.viewport: The document owns most of the window; a quiet top bar handles navigation and a dark contextual margin holds note tools.
options.risk: The familiar layout depends on exceptional spacing and state craft to feel distinctive.

options.label: Fold-out Margin
options.thesis: The note margin becomes an extension of the paper, folding out only when annotation is active.
options.viewport: The PDF expands almost edge to edge while a light 200px note margin attaches directly to its right edge.
options.risk: The light margin gives note mode less separation from document content.

options.label: Reading Spine
options.thesis: Navigation moves to a slim book-like spine, leaving the top folio nearly silent.
options.viewport: A 60px reading rail frames the document on the left while the contextual annotation margin balances it on the right.
options.risk: Moving familiar page controls from the top may slow first-time users.
